certification, proof-assistant verification, or historical-priority claim.
The programme's foundational10/10 objective remains unmet.

MAIN RESULT
Let sigma be any faithful finite-dimensional density and L a positive
sigma-KMS-symmetric quantum Markov generator. Set Gamma(X)=sqrt(sigma)Xsqrt(sigma)
and H=Gamma^(1/2)L Gamma^(-1/2). For every finite untouched reference R and every
faithful joint density rho,

 Tr[(id_R tensor L_*)rho (log rho-I_R tensor log sigma)]
   >= pi Tr[sqrt(rho)(id_R tensor H)sqrt(rho)].

There is no dimension, spectral-gap, commutation, primitivity, or reference-
marginal restriction. An arbitrary faithful reference tau_R cancels from both
sides. Singular input states are covered by the audited extended-real limit;
the stationary density must remain faithful and the dynamics finite-dimensional.
Pi is the sharp universal constant, even when upper witnesses are required to
have primitive generators and faithful states. Fixed-qubit optimality is not
claimed. This closes the earlier general nonlinear and quantum-reference
entropy/root-energy gates at the internal mathematical proof level.

CYCLE08 FINAL MATHEMATICAL DEPENDENCY CLOSURE
Authoritative interpretation of immutable origin, blind and exposed records.
Status: internally proved and adversarially audited. No external mathematical
review, proof-assistant validation or historical-priority clearance. This
checkpoint is PROGRESS; the foundational10/10 objective remains unmet.

1. Main theorem and precise quantifiers

For every finite-dimensional faithful density sigma and every positive
sigma-stationary KMS-symmetric quantum Markov generator L, let
Gamma(X)=sqrt(sigma)Xsqrt(sigma), H=Gamma^(1/2)L Gamma^(-1/2).
For every finite untouched reference R and every faithful joint density rho,

 J_R(rho)=Tr[(id_R tensor L_*)rho(logrho-I_R tensor logsigma)]
       >=pi E_R(rho),
 E_R(rho)=Tr[sqrtrho(id_R tensor H)sqrtrho].

The exact same constant is independent of both dimensions, all eigenvalue
ratios, spectral gap and reference marginal. No GNS/modular covariance,
commuting root/log blocks, primitivity, self-compatibility, EB structure or
information budget is a premise. A faithful product reference tau_R tensor
sigma cancels from both forms. The all-finite theorem applies to every joint
state in its natural extended-real sense by the reviewed singular-input ray.
Stationary sigma must remain faithful. Infinite-dimensional dynamics are not
included.

For each real k>pi there exist a finite dimension, faithful sigma, faithful
rho and a primitive legal KMS generator with E(rho)>0 and J(rho)<kE(rho).
Thus pi is the SHARP universal finite constant, also in the complete class.
This does not identify the optimum at fixed qubit dimension.

2. Exact new mechanism

One elementary noise is H_B(X)={V_B,X}/2-BXB, B=B*, with
V_B=2Lyap_s^-1(BsB), s=sqrt(sigma), Lyap_s(V)=sV+Vs.
Physical jump K=s^(1/2)Bs^(-1/2), drift C=s^(1/2)V_Bs^(-1/2) obey
C+C*=2K*K. C is generally not Hermitian; its Hamiltonian is retained.
Decompose [logs,B_w]=wB_w with B_-w=B_w*. In the FULL joint state eigenbasis
rho=sum_i q_i^2 |i><i| put beta_ij=log(q_i/q_j), c_w(i,j)=<i|B_w|j>.
The exact identity, including diagonal and all coherent frequency pairs, is

 J_B-kE_B=2sum_(i,j) q_iq_j sum_(w,v) conjugate(c_w(i,j))
       K_(k/2)(beta_ij-w,beta_ij-v)c_v(i,j),
 K_(k/2)(x,y)=[x sinh y+y sinh x-2k sinh(x/2)sinh(y/2)]
                                     /[2cosh((x-y)/2)].

CHECKPOINT09 — STATIONARY REGULARITY AND RAW CLASSICALITY
Start with root/CYCLE09_DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE.txt. This states exact theorems,
conventions, proof dependencies, independent/exposed provenance, mandatory
errata, historical limits and unresolved gates. Older conditional/UNKNOWN
wording remains frozen at its original date; the closure supersedes only
the specific dependencies it actually resolves.

Main routes:
- kms-origin and kms-independent: sine lower, signed/polar extension.
- kms-sharpness: independent legal finite upper and LSI consequences.
- kms-review: third positive reconstruction and exposed audit.
- nonkms-lower: actual forward entropy and tangent all-p lower.
- nonkms-gram-review: exact physical identity and Hardy endpoint audit.
- nonkms-p-review: independent kernel/reflection and exposed cross-audit.
- nonkms-upper: physical obstruction, phase upper and MANDATORY
  ERRATUM_PHYSICAL_HAMILTONIAN.txt (Qphys=(C-C*)/(4i)).
- nonkms-physical-review and nonkms-upper-review: legal finite audits.
- raw-origin and raw-review: one-map pointwise/family classicality theorem,
  compact attainment, constructed mediator and copy-deficit floor.
- stationarity-origin and stationarity-review: common full-domain repair.
- petz-origin and petz-review: valid scoped trace bounds and failed transfers.
- *-prior folders: bounded source comparisons; no priority clearance.

KMS and arbitrary stationary classes have different sharp constants.
Non-KMS KT p1 entropy uses the Petz-reversed generator. Positive finite-p
results do not imply a signed/polar non-KMS extension. All local systems and
references are finite; stationary sigma is faithful. The raw theorem requires
one exact common marginal. It is not an optimized observational-radius result.

Read-only replays from the ORIGINAL archived workspace paths:
 python3 work/agents/foundational_transfer_sol/cycle09_nonreversible_lower/REPLAY_DIAGNOSTICS_READ_ONLY.py

 python3 work/agents/algebra_proof_recon/cycle09_nonreversible_review/physical_dim4_reconstruction.py
 python3 work/agents/root_cycle09/check_nonreversible_finite_p_gram.py
The first and last need NumPy. The exact controls use the standard library.
Use original work/ paths because some checkers resolve archived helpers.
